text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Satsuki Sho, Biwa Hayahide is excited to compete with fierce racers like Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Narita Taishin wrestles with the annoyance of constantly being dismissed due to her small stature.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before the race, Biwa Hayahide notices that Narita Taishin seems off and tries to reach out to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, the look in Narita Taishin's eyes indicates that she is in no mood to talk. She leaves without saying a word.
